description: In-play (or final) statistics for one match, in TWO families kept separate on purpose. DERIVED is rebuilt from the point-by-point record (holds/breaks, break points, service/return points). MEASURED is counted per match. It includes what no point record can yield: aces, double faults, the serve split, winners/unforced errors. Measured coverage varies by tour. Absent fields are omitted, never zero-filled. Requires the ULTRA plan.

match_id.description: Match id, as returned by get_live_matches, get_upcoming_matches or get_recent_results.

name: get_match_statistics

message.description: Human-readable summary of the result, safe to relay to the user verbatim.

ok.description: True when the request succeeded, including when the answer is an empty list. False for a missing or rejected key, a plan that does not include this data, an unknown id, a rate limit or a network error. The message then says what to do. check_api_status is the exception: it is true whenever the API answered, and reports API key problems in the message.

as_of.description: When the underlying record was last updated (UTC).

coverage.description: live | final | stale | none | diverged. Summarises the response.

freshness.description: Per-family coverage/as_of/age. The two ages use DIFFERENT clocks (derived: against the newest score row, measured: wall clock) and must not be compared. On diverged the measured values are withheld and measured_divergence says why.

games_counted.description: Games the derived family covers (tiebreaks excluded, counted separately).

derived.description: Rebuilt from the point-by-point record: service/return games and points, hold_pct, break_pct, break points faced/saved/converted. Null percentages mean a zero denominator, never 0.

measured.description: Counted per match: aces, double_faults, the serve split, winners/unforced errors where covered. Absent fields are omitted, never zero-filled. Quantities named in both families are computed two different ways: a cross-check, not a duplication.

players.description: Null when coverage is none. The match exists, and holding nothing is the honest answer.

title: Match statistics
